name: Hernádszentandrás (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hernádszentandrás: a crowned blue shield with a figure holding a saltire cross, with red and yellow mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
